tools.name: mcp_list_servers
tools.description: List the MCP servers configured for this bot: name, transport, connection state and tool count. Use it when a task may need an external service.

summary.zh: 列出配置的 MCP 服务器、连接状态与工具数量。
summary.en: Lists the configured MCP servers with their connection state and tool counts.

tools.name: mcp_list_tools
tools.description: List the tools an MCP server exposes, with each input schema. Call it before mcp_call_tool; pass refresh when the server may have changed. Omit server to see every connected server.

query.description: Keep tools whose name or description contains this text.

detail.description: Include each input schema; false lists names and descriptions only.

refresh.description: Ask the server for its tool list again before answering.

summary.zh: 列出一个 MCP 服务器的工具及每个工具的输入 schema。
summary.en: Lists an MCP server's tools with each input schema.

tools.name: mcp_call_tool
tools.description: Call one tool on an MCP server. arguments must match the input schema mcp_list_tools reports; a failure receipt carries the server's reason.

arguments.description: Arguments object for the tool; omit when it takes none.

summary.zh: 调用 MCP 服务器上的一个工具，回执是该服务器的输出或失败原因。
summary.en: Calls one tool on an MCP server; the receipt is its output or its failure reason.

description.zh: 已连接的 MCP 服务器断开，正文带断开原因。
description.en: A connected MCP server went away; the text carries the reason.

prompts.title: MCP · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
## MCP

Some capabilities on this machine come from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Their tools are not in your tool list; three tools reach them:

- `mcp_list_servers` — which servers are configured, whether they are connected, and how many tools each has.
- `mcp_list_tools` — one server's tools and their input schemas.
- `mcp_call_tool` — run one tool with `server`, `tool` and `arguments`.

Connected now:

{{mcp.catalog}}

Call `mcp_list_tools` before the first `mcp_call_tool` to a server, and again with `refresh` when a tool it reported is missing or changed. Pass arguments exactly as the schema names them; omit `arguments` for a tool that takes none. A receipt that starts with `[tool failed]` carries the server's own reason: report that instead of retrying blindly.

These calls act outside the app. Do what the person asked for, and say what changed.
